Distinct question text -> distinct content_hash; answers kept verbatim as printed for both.

q14 answer: 2 top-level bullets + 4 indented sub-items (Kennedy's four rights under the 2nd bullet) -> flattened to 6 sequential solution_steps in reading order (nesting not modelled; content/order preserved).
q16 answer spans pdf120->121 (first 2 bullets on 120, remaining 3 on 121) = 5 bullets.

questions.text: Mention the methods to be followed to file a case in a consumer commission/court?
questions.text_as_printed: Mention the methods to be followed to file a case in a consumer commission/court? (Average)

answer.value:
There is no prescribed proforma to file a case.
Complaint may be a typed one or hand written.
Complaint should include the name of the person (complainant), Full address and Telephone Number.
Person or organisation against whom the complaint is made should be mentioned clearly with address.
Particulars of the goods, the amount of loss should be specified clearly.
The bill or receipt should be enclosed.
There is no fees or stamp duty for the complaint.
No advocate or lawyer is required.
The consumer himself/ herself can argue.
